claim: No registered secret can appear in an emitted artifact — the emitter redacts, then re-reads its own serialized output and refuses to emit if any secret survived.

steps.label: a secret nested inside an artifact
a secret embedded in a log line keeps its surroundings
one secret containing another leaves no fragment
steps.note: Replacing the shorter secret first would shred the longer one and leave half of it in the output.

steps.label: output that reached the emitter already containing a secret
steps.evidence: the failure names only the placeholder, never the secret
steps.note: The emitter does not trust its own redactor; it re-reads the finished bytes.
